content:
Apple CarPlay now supports six major third-party AI chatbot apps. Microsoft Copilot is the latest iPhone app to add CarPlay support.

Microsoft Copilot joins CarPlay, leaving Gemini as the biggest platform still without support

Copilot's addition leaves Google Gemini as the final major AI chatbot platform without support.

Starting Monday, CarPlay will add a dedicated Siri AI app. iOS 27 will then officially launch, ending its beta phase. Siri AI itself is still in beta and will roll out in phases.

In the meantime, Microsoft has added CarPlay support to its Copilot chatbot iPhone app. CarPlay's conversational apps require iOS 26.4 or later.

Copilot appears to require a subscription to use on CarPlay. This voice-operated app syncs chat history from within the iPhone app, including the content of text conversations.

Here is the app in action:

As mentioned earlier, with Microsoft Copilot landing on CarPlay, only one major platform remains without support in the AI app space: Google Gemini.

Joining Copilot on CarPlay's optional apps are Siri AI, OpenAI's ChatGPT, Perplexity, SpaceXAI's Grok, Meta AI, and Anthropic's Claude.
